# BD3 — Agent Spec Sheet (GROUND TRUTH)

**Solution:** KSE Memory SDK v3 — Universal Hybrid Knowledge Substrate (SOL-01)
**This document wins.** Where BD docs disagree, BD3 is authoritative. Update BD3 first, then propagate.

## Current State (2026-08-29)

**Phase:** Phase 0 — credibility triage (pre-build)
**Stack:** Python SDK v2.0.0 on PyPI. core/ (memory orchestrator, interfaces, config, models, domain_mapping), services/ (embedding, conceptual, search, cache), backends/ (11 stores incl. mock), adapters/, integrations/ (LangChain, LlamaIndex), temporal/, federated/, visual/. ~21k LOC.
**API surface:** Library API: KSEMemory.initialize/add_product/search; CLI: kse quickstart; LangChain KSEVectorStore; LlamaIndex retriever.
**Pending:** Written record of EY sanction before public launch push; confirm ⚠ p95 latency target during build

### Known defects to remediate
- Hybrid fusion is fixed-weight linear sum over incompatible score scales — replace with RRF (FR-05)
- Conceptual query extraction is keyword matching against a hardcoded 10-dim fashion vocabulary — replace with schema + anchor-embedding similarity (FR-03)
- core/domain_mapping.map_dimensions is an identity stub ('For now, return the same values')
- services/conceptual.py uses deprecated openai.ChatCompletion API
- README v2 carries simulated benchmark figures presented as empirical — retract (US-1)
- ~20 generated status markdowns in repo root — consolidate into docs/ (US-1)
- Tests are heavily mocked (48 mock refs) — CI currently proves the mocks work

## Projections spec

- **Index types:** vector index, feature store, cache (keyword/BM25 channel: recommended addition, not in v3.0 scope unless US5 benchmarks justify)
- **Granularity:** Record/item level (document level for corpora) · **Views:** text, metadata, dimension score vectors, graph edges
- **Embedding models:** Default all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (ONNX, int8); quality bge-small-en-v1.5; scale model2vec potion-base-8M (>1M items); ANN hnswlib/usearch.
- **Graph backend tiers:** T1 CI-covered: NetworkX (default), Neo4j. T2 community: ArangoDB, TypeDB. T3 connectors: Rainbird (reasoning channel), Alphient Prime (platform connector); Barnacle Alexandria adjacent/interop.
- **Training data:** Gold relevance judgements from pinned public datasets (BEIR SciFact/NFCorpus/FiQA + Amazon ESCI attribute slice) under benchmarks/; optional user click feedback for learned fusion.
- **Update cadence:** Real-time incremental upserts; batch rebuild on schema/model semver bump.

## Flow steps (FR)

- **FR-01** — Ingest: adapter pulls item → normalise to universal record; SHA-256 content hash for dedupe/replay
- **FR-02** — Project: embed text (ONNX MiniLM default) · score dimensions vs user schema (LLM or local scorer) · upsert graph edges — all incremental
- **FR-03** — Query parse: embed query; map to dimension targets via embedding similarity against each dimension's anchor descriptions
- **FR-04** — Retrieve concurrently: vector top-k · conceptual top-k over feature store · graph traversal top-k
- **FR-05** — Fuse: RRF default (rank-based, scale-free); optional min-max normalised weighted fusion; learned fusion later opt-in
- **FR-06** — Explain: attach per-channel ranks, scores and per-dimension breakdown to every result
- **FR-07** — Fallback: failed/empty channels degrade gracefully; below-threshold fused confidence → dense-only + explicit flag

## Guardrails (AR) — all confirmed, none TBD

- **AR-01** (confirmed) — Default path makes zero network calls; quickstart requires no API key (verifiable: network-mocked CI test asserts no socket use)
- **AR-02** (confirmed) — Simulation code isolated under simulations/ with warning headers; import from benchmarks/ is a CI failure
- **AR-03** (confirmed) — README performance claims must reference a benchmark artefact regenerable by make bench (CI link-check)
- **AR-04** (confirmed) — No CUDA/GPU package in the default dependency tree (CI asserts pip install on CPU-only image succeeds with no NVIDIA deps)
- **AR-05** (confirmed) — Public API fully typed; mypy clean on kse_memory public surface

## Edge cases (EC)

| ID | Case |
|---|---|
| EC-01 | Score-scale mismatch across channels — must never distort fused ranking (mitigated by RRF) |
| EC-02 | Missing channel: no graph configured or no dimension schema — degrade to 2-channel/1-channel mode with explanation flag |
| EC-03 | Cold start: items queried before dimension scoring completes — serve available channels, flag partial coverage |
| EC-04 | Conflicting channel rankings — surface disagreement in per-channel breakdown rather than hiding it |
| EC-05 | Non-English corpora — embedding model default is English-biased; document limitation, allow model swap |
| EC-06 | Corpus exceeds in-memory backends — document SQLite/hnswlib limits and Tier 1/2 upgrade path |
